verdict.body: MATCH -- meologue now renders the project name bare, exactly as Todoist does. The 2026-09-12 reading (flow9-STR-01-both.json) found meologue wrapping the name in ASCII double quotes ("The \"ZZ probe\" project..."); defect 31's project-view.tsx:416 site is fixed.
verdict.domRole: DIVERGES, unchanged and by design -- Todoist uses role=dialog, meologue uses role=alertdialog. This was already ratified by the user on 2026-09-13 (per the ledger's own note) as an accessibility surplus in meologue's favour, not a defect, so it is recorded here rather than counted against the row.
verdict.overallStatus: MATCH on the wording defect this row was reopened for (defect 31); the role difference remains a known, ratified divergence.
